## TL;DR

**The community has consolidated on one successor: [caozhiyuan/copilot-api](https://github.com/caozhiyuan/copilot-api)** (npm `@jeffreycao/copilot-api`). Issue [#233](https://github.com/ericc-ch/copilot-api/issues/233) in the original repo officially points to it. I ran it locally on port 4142 and verified: **extended thinking returns real thinking blocks, WebSearch actually works (returned Node.js LTS v24.18.0 with source links), tool round-trips are native-passthrough**, and hyphenated model ids are normalized. It's the clear best practice.

Bonus discovery while testing: **Claude Code currently lets `settings.local.json` env override shell env vars** — my first fork test silently went to your 4141 proxy because your repo has `copilot-here on` active. This contradicts third-party docs and slightly weakens our Layer-1 wrapper (details below).

## Fork landscape (all candidates, verified via npm + GitHub)

| Fork / npm package | Version | Downloads/mo | Last release | Key approach |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **`@jeffreycao/copilot-api`** (caozhiyuan, 891 stars) | 1.13.14 | 19,552 | 2026-07-01 (near-daily) | Native Anthropic `/v1/messages` passthrough + Responses-API WebSearch + dashboard |
| `copilot-api-node20` (johnib) | 0.37.1 | 3,706 | 2026-07-02 | Native `/v1/messages` passthrough for Claude (created specifically to fix the tool-loop bug [#46](https://github.com/ericc-ch/copilot-api/issues/46)) |
| `@hsupu/copilot-api` (puxu-msft/copilot-api-js) | 0.8.2 | 1,593 | 2026-06-30 | OpenAI+Anthropic+AOAI+Gemini endpoints, `opus[1m]` aliases |
| `betahi-copilot-api` ([#240](https://github.com/ericc-ch/copilot-api/issues/240)) | 0.7.5 | 100 | 2026-04-27 | Reasoning-effort control (`COPILOT_REASONING_EFFORT`); semi-stale |
| `copilot-api` (ericc-ch, original — what you run) | 0.7.0 | 3,597 | 2025-10-05, **dead** | Anthropic→OpenAI→Anthropic translation (the root cause of most gaps) |

The winner's issue tracker is remarkably responsive — feature requests filed and closed within a day (HTTPS, startup smoke-test, Tavily/Exa search grounding, all closed 2026-07-01), and the `context_management` regression ([#305](https://github.com/caozhiyuan/copilot-api/issues/305)) gets maintainer replies same-day.

## What I verified live (fork v1.13.14, port 4142, your token)

- **Thinking blocks: fixed.** `thinking: enabled` returned `["thinking","text"]` content with `thinking_tokens: 138` in usage — v0.7.0 silently dropped these. It routes Claude traffic to Copilot's native Anthropic endpoint (your account is Copilot Enterprise: `api.enterprise.githubcopilot.com/v1/messages`).
- **WebSearch: fixed.** Real headless Claude Code run: "1 search performed, Node.js LTS is v24.18.0" with nodejs.org citations. It routes WebSearch through a Responses-capable GPT model (default config `messageApiWebSearchModel: "gpt-5-mini"`, already enabled out of the box). Caveat: my raw-API probe hit one transient 500 in the same route, so treat it as working-but-occasionally-flaky.
- **Tool use: native round-trip works**; this architecture eliminates the translation-mangling class of bugs behind the infinite tool-retry loops in the original.
- **Hyphenated ids (`claude-haiku-4-5`): accepted** — the Claude Code 2.1.x compatibility issue is gone, and cache/usage fields are properly reported (`cache_creation`, `cache_read_input_tokens`).
- **Known wart:** injecting `context_management` (newer Claude Code context-editing) gets a 400 from Copilot's native endpoint ([#305](https://github.com/caozhiyuan/copilot-api/issues/305), version-dependent). Real Claude Code runs in my tests didn't trigger it, but it's the one issue to watch.

## Best practice if you switch

1. `COPILOT_API_PKG` can't just be swapped — the fork's `start` has **no `--rate-limit`/`--wait` flags** (I read its `src/start.ts`), so `copilot-proxy start` needs a small adjustment. It also has no rate limiting at all; the README's mitigation is reducing chatter instead: `CLAUDE_CODE_ATTRIBUTION_HEADER=0` (also prevents prompt-cache invalidation), `CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_PROMPT_SUGGESTION=false`, `CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_AWAY_SUMMARY=0` — worth adding to `copilot-here`/`copilot-run` env regardless.
2. It reuses the same `~/.local/share/copilot-api/github_token`, so no re-auth needed (verified — it booted straight into the model list), and it bundles the usage dashboard locally (`/usage-viewer`).
3. `bunx @jeffreycao/copilot-api@<pin> start --port 4141` works today as a manual trial.

## One finding that affects our own design

The empirical precedence in current Claude Code is: **`.claude/settings.local.json` env beats inherited shell env** (my `env ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=4142 claude ...` run from this repo was served by 4141 until I moved to a neutral directory). Practical consequence: `claude-copilot` cannot override a project where `copilot-here on` is active — harmless when both point at the same proxy, but it inverts the mental model in our docs. Worth a gotcha note in `copilot-claude-proxy.md`, and it means "try the fork on another port via the wrapper" requires `copilot-here off` first.

Want me to migrate `43_copilot_proxy.sh` + docs to the fork (pinned, with the extra quota-saving env and the precedence gotcha documented)?
